description: This file contains the implementation of ignition and spark control logic for an engine management system, including functions for scheduling ignition events, controlling spark pins, handling ignition errors, and initializing ignition logic components.

classes.name: IgnitionEventList
classes.description: A class managing a list of ignition events, including their initialization and readiness state.

methods.name: isInjectionEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether fuel injection is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: isIgnitionTimingError
methods.description: Checks whether ignition timing error detection exceeds threshold.

methods.name: turnSparkPinLow2
methods.description: Sets a spark output pin low, with optional logging.

methods.name: prepareCylinderIgnitionSchedule
methods.description: Prepares ignition schedule parameters for a specific cylinder based on engine configuration and timing.

methods.name: turnSparkPinLow
methods.description: Turns off the spark pins for an ignition event.

methods.name: turnSparkPinHigh2
methods.description: Sets a spark output pin high, with optional logging and error checks.

methods.name: turnSparkPinHigh
methods.description: Turns on the spark pins for an ignition event.

methods.name: handleSparkEvent
methods.description: Handles scheduling the spark event, including timing and logging, for a specific ignition event.

methods.name: initializeIgnitionActions
methods.description: Initializes ignition event list based on engine parameters and configuration.

methods.name: prepareIgnitionSchedule
methods.description: Prepares the entire ignition schedule for the engine cycle.

methods.name: handleSpark
methods.description: Main function to handle ignition events and schedule spark timing for a given revolution and RPM.

methods.name: initSparkLogic
methods.description: Initializes the spark logic module with shared logger.

methods.name: getNumberOfSparks
methods.description: Returns the number of sparks per cycle based on the ignition mode.

methods.name: getCoilDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duty cycle percentage for the ignition coil based on RPM.
